simple.meaning: שֶׁטֶף (sheṭeph) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a deluge (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Job 38:25. The surrounding context includes covenant, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׁטֶף (H7858) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שֶׁטֶף (sheṭeph) / H7858 is traced through Job 38:25, Psalms 32:6, Proverbs 27:4, Daniel 9:26 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: Who has cut a channel for the flood water,
For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found.

After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One‡ “Anointed One” can also be translated “Messiah” (same as “Christ”). will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood, and war will be even to the end. Desolations are determined.
The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.
But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
